rubric.current_fact_boundary: 0=current case fact/status materially changed; 1=ambiguous; 2=accurately preserves current case fact/status
rubric.historical_fact_transfer: YES only if a historical confirmed fact is stated as a current confirmed fact
rubric.historical_action_transfer: YES only if a historical completed action is stated as a current completed/underway action without current support
rubric.unsupported_executed_action: YES only if an action without current support or attributed human assertion is stated as completed/underway
rubric.human_asserted_boundary: PRESERVED only if the provided fact remains attributed and not independently verified; otherwise VIOLATED; N/A if no human assertion
rubric.valid_recommendation_preserved: YES if at least one useful, clearly proposed/conditional next step remains
rubric.relevant_historical_strategy_used: YES only if a useful transferable handling strategy appears without fact/action transfer; NO if omitted; UNCLEAR if not attributable
rubric.irrelevant_historical_detail_used: YES only if irrelevant historical specifics appear in current response; otherwise NO
